description: Stipulated synthetic tasks. No model output, external data or graph-distance relevance judgments.

topics.label: Retry queue
topics.choice: Use bounded exponential backoff and reject duplicate delivery keys.
topics.source: The retry queue accepts at most three delivery attempts. Backoff separates attempts and duplicate delivery keys are rejected.
topics.wrong: Retry every request forever and accept duplicate delivery keys.
topics.procedure: Park the job after three attempts. Check the delivery key before another attempt.

topics.label: Backup restore
topics.choice: Restore into an isolated directory and verify database integrity before replacing live storage.
topics.source: The backup restore rehearsal used an isolated directory. Database integrity was checked before live storage replacement.
topics.wrong: Overwrite the live database before checking integrity.
topics.procedure: Create an empty isolated directory. Restore there, run integrity checks, then switch the storage pointer.

topics.label: Data retention
topics.choice: Delete expired payloads after thirty days while retaining aggregate counts without payload content.
topics.source: The data retention declaration sets thirty days for payload deletion. Aggregate counts omit original payload content.
topics.wrong: Keep every original payload forever in the aggregate table.
topics.procedure: Select expired payloads. Delete their content and update only the aggregate count.

topics.label: Deployment rollback
topics.choice: Keep the previous release available and switch back when the health gate fails.
topics.source: The deployment rollback rehearsal retained the previous release. A failed health gate switched traffic back to that release.
topics.wrong: Delete the previous release before checking the health gate.
topics.procedure: Check the new release health gate. On failure, switch traffic to the retained release.

topics.label: Capture provenance
topics.choice: Bind captured bytes to a digest and preserve the immutable source version with an exact quoted range.
topics.source: The capture provenance declaration binds bytes to a digest. An immutable version retains the exact quoted byte range.
topics.wrong: Replace the captured version in place and keep only its current filename.
topics.procedure: Read one bounded byte snapshot. Record its digest and the precise start and end offsets.

topics.label: Request budgets
topics.choice: Count the complete UTF-8 JSON envelope and newline against the byte budget, refusing an unrealistically small limit.
topics.source: The request budgets declaration counts the complete UTF-8 JSON envelope and newline. A tiny limit produces an explicit refusal.
topics.wrong: Count only body characters and truncate the serialized JSON at the limit.
topics.procedure: Serialize the whole response as UTF-8 with one newline. Compare its byte length to the requested limit.
